Phase I of the technical program consisted of the development and design of the housing systems for the demonstration projects. This work was undertaken under direct contract with HUD, with the system designs being based upon and evaluated against a set of performance—oriented standards, known as the "Guide Criteria for the Evaluation of Operation BREAKTHROUGH Housing Systems."
These Guide Criteria were developed by the National Bureau of Standards under HUD sponsorship, and have been reviewed and approved by a joint Advisory Committee to the Department of Housing and Urban Devolopment (ACHUD) of the National Academies of Sciences and Engineering. The Guide Criteria address all elements of housing, establishing for the first time performance standards which can be used for the evaluation of innovative approaches.
Phase II of the technical program involves the demonstration of prototype housing models from these systems on the prototype sites. Site characteristics vary from central city, urban renewal properties to suburban neighborhoods. Selection criteria included analysis of physical characteristics such as soil conditions, neighborhood environment and availability of public services; geographic location and weather history; housing demand and the nature of this demand, including the possibility of providing for a mix of income and ethnic characteristics; and the willingness of the local public officials to cooperate in relaxing existing zoning, building, housing and other codes and regulations so as to permit testing of impovative concepts.
Because housing is more than the structure, and because the effective use of land must be improved both to provide a better living environment and to reduce the impact of land costs on the total cost of housing, the prototype sites are considered as demonstrations not only of the housing systems but of innovative planning methods. The planning teams were chosen to include all of the disciplines required to undertake this effort, including the ability to evaluate and respond to site environmental characteristics.
Important site environmental impacts are discussed in Part 2 of this Statement. General information on environmental characteristics for the prototype sites is given in Appendix I.
